items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We only had "St. Louis Blues" for her to sing.

ctx.x: We only had "St. Louis Blues" for her to sing. She was out of meter but we'd follow her, but she looked good. She had this white gown and another gown - there were only two dresses. Ken Bluett bought it. He was the manager of the Regal. I went with him and got in his car to get this thing and I went up and got Baby Lawrence and when I come in Dickie Wells said, "Man, he's a singer. He was with Don Redman when he was 14." I said, "Yeh, but he can dance."
